summary.text: Dave Pinto is a Democratic member of the Minnesota House of Representatives for District 64B who has served since January 2015 and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026.

paragraphs.text: Dave Pinto was unopposed in the 2014 Democratic primary for District 64B and defeated Republican Daniel Surman in the general election, assuming office on January 6, 2015.

In the 2025-2026 session he was assigned to the Fraud Prevention and State Agency Oversight Policy (DFL Lead), Public Safety and Criminal Justice Reform Finance and Policy, Ways and Means, and Workforce and Business Development Finance and Policy (Co-Chair) committees.
No Republican candidate is listed for the November 3, 2026 general election for the seat.
